title: Bayesian machine learning identifies concussion from MRI connectome features
summary: A Bayesian classifier using fractional anisotropy of white matter connections was tested on a discovery sample of 92 healthy controls and 471 mild TBI participants and on an independent sample of 256 controls and 126 concussion cases, with reported accuracy above 99%. Thirteen bilateral connection pairs were found predictive. The accuracy may reflect confounds such as age differences between groups.
ai_technology: Bayesian machine learning classifier on MRI connectome features

evidence.tested: Classification of concussion versus controls in a discovery sample and an independent replication sample.
evidence.unknown: Very high accuracy may reflect age or site confounds; prospective use not shown; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Bayesian classifier on white matter connectivity features to identify concussion.
